models.name: ResearchQuery
models.description: Normalized research brief — topic plus full goals text.

models.name: SearchHit
models.description: One n8n / search-API hit — URL plus optional HTML snapshot.

fields.name: snippet
fields.description: Search snippet fallback when html is empty

fields.name: html
fields.description: HTML snapshot from n8n HTTP Request; omit to live-fetch

models.name: SearchHitFile
models.description: n8n-shaped search payload — query plus results array.

models.name: ResearchBundle
models.description: Brief query plus n8n search hits merged by combine.

models.name: ScrapedPage
models.description: Plain-text page after HTML strip or live fetch.

models.name: PageExtract
models.description: Structured facts from one scraped page.

fields.name: quote
fields.description: Short verbatim span from the page

models.name: BriefingRequest
models.description: Research query plus extracted page facts for the final LLM.

models.name: ResearchBriefing
models.description: Final research briefing with cited sources.

modules.label: Research Brief
modules.inputDescription: Plain-text research question and coverage goals
modules.note: Research question — feeds topic/goals via Parse Brief

modules.label: Parse Brief
modules.note: Document → ResearchQuery — first heading is topic, full text is goals.
modules.inputDescription: Research brief Document with plain-text content

fallbackList.typescript: (doc) => { const text = String(doc?.content ?? "").trim(); const first = (text.split("\n").find((l) => l.trim()) ?? text).replace(/^#\s*/, "").trim(); if (!first) throw new Error("research brief is empty"); return { topic: first, goals: text }; }

modules.label: Search Hits
modules.inputDescription: n8n-shaped JSON with query, provider, and results array of url/title/snippet/html
modules.note: Search API / n8n output — side input for combine (must follow Parse Brief on spine)

modules.label: Combine Inputs
modules.note: Merges ResearchQuery (pipeline state) with Search Hits side input.
modules.inputDescription: SearchHitFile (new input) plus ResearchQuery from Parse Brief on pipeline state

modules.label: Parse Hits
modules.note: ResearchBundle → list[SearchHit] — results from the merged search field.
modules.inputDescription: ResearchBundle from combine — query + search hits

fallbackList.typescript: (bundle) => { const rows = bundle?.search?.results; if (!Array.isArray(rows)) throw new Error("expected search.results array"); return rows; }

modules.label: Scrape Pages
modules.note: Python strip/fetch with optional Ray fan-out; TypeScript fallback strips html snapshots only.
modules.inputDescription: list[SearchHit] from Parse Hits — url, title, optional html snapshot

fallbackList.typescript:
(hits) => { // AI : snapshot-only fallback — no live fetch (CORS).
 const rows = Array.isArray(hits) ? hits : []; const strip = (html) => String(html ?? "").replace(/<script[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, " ").replace(/<style[^>]*>[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, " ").replace(/<[^>]+>/g, " ").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim(); return rows.map((row) => { const text = (strip(row?.html) || String(row?.snippet ?? "").trim()).slice(0, 12000); return { url: String(row?.url ?? ""), title: String(row?.title ?? ""), text, status: text ? "ok" : "empty" }; }); }

modules.label: ✓ Scrape Pages
modules.note: Golden fixture — HTML snapshots strip to ScrapedPage rows
modules.inputDescription: List of ScrapedPage objects — url, title, stripped text, status

fallbackList.python:
pages = step('Scrape Pages')
hits = step('Parse Hits')
if len_of(pages) != len_of(hits):
    raise ValueError(f'expected {len_of(hits)} scraped pages, got {len_of(pages)}')

modules.label: Extract Facts
modules.note: list[ScrapedPage] → list[PageExtract]. One structured LLM call per page.
modules.inputDescription: List of ScrapedPage objects — url, title, and stripped page text
modules.prompt: Extract structured facts from this scraped page. Copy url and title unchanged. Set source_name to the product, project, or site this page is about. key_facts must be concrete claims from the page text (not the snippet alone). quote must be a short verbatim span copied from text. Ignore nav/boilerplate.

modules.label: Merge for Briefing
modules.note: Deep-merge Parse Brief (pipeline state) with extracts from Extract Facts → BriefingRequest.
modules.inputDescription: Filtered PageExtract rows from each scraped page

modules.label: Write Briefing
modules.note: Final briefing using the research goals and per-page extracts.
modules.inputDescription: BriefingRequest with topic, goals, and extracts
modules.prompt: Write a concise research briefing for topic using goals as the assignment. Use extracts only — each row has url, source_name, key_facts, and quote. findings should answer how Python teams scrape in parallel (Ray) and how n8n fits as a search/orchestration layer. sources must be the extract urls, one per line of the list. Do not invent pages that were not extracted.

modules.label: Briefing Output
modules.inputDescription: ResearchBriefing with title, executive_summary, findings, and sources

modules.label: ✓ Extract Facts
modules.note: Structural check — one extract per scraped page, urls preserved
modules.inputDescription: ResearchBriefing passthrough — assert reads Extract Facts from pipeline state
